findings.message: Function get_magic_quotes_gpc() is deprecated since PHP 7.4 and removed since PHP 8.0

Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like func_get_args(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$method" was changed on line 198. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: func_get_args() and similar report the current value of a changed parameter, and code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this, so the upgrade changes nothing)
